issues: 急推前 40f 全景死帧，无蓄力，冲击感只靠 6f 本身
CameraMotionBlur 在近静止帧压灰底色、卡片偏黄，急推前出现色闪
震屏只有单一 sin 平移，方向随机，没有“砸下去”的重量方向感
撞停后画面亮度、焦点毫无变化，重量感只靠抖动传达
changes: 全景段 1→1.02 smooth creep + 8f 预备回拉到 0.99，急推改 quart-in（EASE.exit）速度峰值砸在到位帧
自写时间采样运动模糊（快门 0.55f，子帧数按位移自适应，上限 40），只包 40–45f 急推段，震屏段保持清晰
震屏改 cos 起相：首拍沿冲击方向下沉、相邻帧近乎反号的高频硬抖，x 轴 0.55 幅度 + ≤0.35° 微旋转，包络保持 14px·e^(−t/1.8)
撞停帧暗角猛压到 0.3 再 16f 退到 0.12，周边页面 8f 内轻压暗 8%，目标卡不浮起——砸实而非弹起
issuesEn: The 40-frame wide hold before the push is dead, with no wind-up; all the impact rests on the 6 frames themselves
CameraMotionBlur greys the background and yellows the cards on near-static frames, flashing before the push
The shake is a single sine translation in an arbitrary direction, with no sense of weight slamming down
Nothing in brightness or focus changes after the hit; weight is conveyed by the shake alone
changesEn: Smooth 1→1.02 creep during the hold plus an 8-frame wind-up to 0.99; the crash uses quart-in (EASE.exit) so peak speed lands on the hit frame
Custom temporal motion blur (0.55f shutter, adaptive sample count up to 40) only on the 40–45f push; the shake stays crisp

Shake is now cosine-phased: the first beat sinks along the impact direction and adjacent frames nearly flip sign for a hard high-frequency jolt, 0.55 x-amplitude plus ≤0.35° micro-rotation, envelope still 14px·e^(−t/1.8)
On the hit frame the vignette slams to 0.3 then relaxes to 0.12 over 16 frames, and the surroundings dim 8% within 8 frames; the target does not lift, so it lands rather than bounces
